notes: Re-run of the eight approved ETA-351 scenarios after the governed restart of WF-ETA-351-R1.0. All eight passed first time against the live qa1 application; no failure, no triage branch, no healing attempt and no defect.

The automation was not regenerated. Gate 3 v2 Option A confirmed the existing code, so this run exercises the same page objects and step definitions that EXEC-ETA-351-001 exercised, against the application as it stands on 2026-09-04. That is what makes it a regression check rather than a re-test of freshly written code.
Negative scenarios submit only fabricated values from test-data/account-access.sample.json. Only TS-ETA-351-005 uses the real organization account.

Browser code coverage was captured during this run and written to reports/coverage/. It measures which application JavaScript executed and is not requirement coverage; it is recorded nowhere in traceability/ and proves nothing about any acceptance criterion.

scenarios.gherkinScenario: The login page offers a way to declare the kind of sign-in before any details are entered
Both supported sign-in kinds are offered and can be told apart
Choosing organization sign-in makes the page ask for the organization details rather than every possible field
The password is not readable on screen as it is typed
Correct organization details admit the user to the eCore Command Center Home page
Wrong details do not admit the user and the user is told what happened
Required details left out do not admit the user and the user is told what happened
The response to wrong details differs from the response to missing details
